title: Park Scene 8 — Helping Clean Up
purpose: Functional social language, helping, tidying and simple cause-and-effect.

sentenceModels: The children are cleaning the park.
The child is picking up a bottle.
The child is carrying rubbish to the bin.

adultSupport.focus: Use the scene for helping language, what should happen next, and simple functional choices.
starterPrompts: What should go in the bin?
expansionPrompts: Why are they putting the rubbish in the bin?
Can you tell me the clean-up story from first to last?

visualAudit: Reviewed in Wave 3 Batch 2 automatic pass against the visible teaching targets.
